encounters.title: The Missing Golden Apple
encounters.firstLine: The Bifrost is sealed. The watch is searching for Odin’s missing golden apple.
encounters.alarmLine: If you find it, please return it. It is definitely not in my pocket.
epilogue: ROYAL WATCH: The Bifrost is closed while we search for Odin’s missing golden apple.
LOKI: A tragic day for apples. And for gates.
